title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the electric field magnitude at point M using E = kQ/r² with proper unit conversion (30 cm → 0.30 m).

title: Electric field direction
description: Important Criteria: The student must specify the direction of the electric field at M (away from positive Q, toward M if OM is along the line).

title: Potential difference relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the given potential difference (φ_M - φ_N = 20 V) to the work done by the field: W = q(φ_M - φ_N).

title: Potential energy change
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute the change in electric potential energy as ΔU = -W = -q(φ_M - φ_N) and obtain the correct numerical value with sign.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent SI units throughout calculations and express final answers with appropriate units.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student confuses the sign in W = qΔV or misidentifies ΔV = φ_M - φ_N versus φ_N - φ_M.

title: Distance unit mistake
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses r = 30 cm without converting to meters, leading to an incorrect electric field.
